changes.title: The full above-default upgrade-scroll scoring curve now reaches 20 percent smoothly
changes.text: The earlier endpoint-only interpretation is superseded. New runs keep 15 scrolls at 1.0x and 60 scrolls at 0.20x, with every count16 through59 explicitly rescaled from the original v2.6R curve so count59 is 0.2171939182010963x and no approximately37-point cliff remains. Scroll generation, the1-to60 range, step1, default15, gameplay RNG and every non-scroll scoring lookup position are unchanged.

changes.title: Original and endpoint-only runs retain their exact frozen scoring authority
changes.text: The original v1 calculation remains exact, including 60 scrolls at 0.5608735153608649x. The short-lived endpoint-only v2 calculation also remains exact for frozen runs, with its original count16-through59 values and count60 at0.20x. Only newly created runs use v3; saved calculation version and multiplier continue to validate history without repricing.

changes.title: Exact table, continuity and native current-score regressions
changes.text: Full core-only run39862190948 passed2050 tests in397 suites with zero failures, errors or skips.
